You’ve poured yourself into philosophy, consciousness, reality, and then suddenly the world that felt structured and certain collapses. That kind of rupture can make everything feel strange, including the people around you. And when meditation opens you to deeper layers of experience, it’s natural to start seeing the everyday world as "hollow" or "scripted."

The idea that you’re an "original soul" while others are "copies or echoes"—I don’t think that makes you crazy. It’s a very understandable way to make sense of feeling unseen, unheard, and out of sync. Many people have felt that same isolation. That wouldn’t make you any less special. It would make you human—beautifully, agonizingly human.
